English rendering (ours): "On June twentieth Tippelskirch’s fifth brigade moved before Maubeuge, held by 3,000, mostly French National Guards; the governor was Latour Maubourg and commandant de Maret."

claims.value: Plotho distinguishes Latour Maubourg as governor and de Maret as commandant. On June 24 Prince August took overall corps/blockade command and assigned Maubeuge’s special siege command to Pirch I; Tippelskirch led the initial investment.
claims.rationale: Different superior/local offices and dates; no equal or continuous credit. English rendering (ours): "Latour Maubourg was governor, de Maret commandant; on June twenty-fourth Pirch deployed the blockade corps, and Prince August assumed overall command."

claims.rationale: Separate historical milestones and disagreement with frozen endpoint retained; no expansion of frame or replacement of winner. English rendering (ours): "Plotho: June twentieth–July eleventh; capitulation on July eleventh; departure and Prussian occupation July fourteenth. Vaudoncourt: Maubeuge July fourteenth."
